## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and followed the voice spec.
- [ ] `npm run dev` renders the page correctly.
- [ ] `npm run audit` passes (no dead links).
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes.
- [ ] `npm run review:all` shows no new HIGH issues.
- [ ] If this is a new page: frontmatter has title, slug, section, summary, order, status, emoji.
- [ ] No real customer data, personal phone numbers, or other PII added.
